questions.question: What phrase is repeated in every verse of Psalm 136?
options: For his steadfast love endures forever
For his judgments are righteous and true
For his temple stands in glory on Zion
For his name is great among the nations
questions.answer: For his steadfast love endures forever

questions.question: What acts of God does Psalm 136 recount with the refrain?
options: The law, the tabernacle, and the building of the temple
The exile, the return, and the rebuilding of the walls
The flood, the tower, and the call of Abraham
Creation, the exodus, and the giving of the land
questions.answer: Creation, the exodus, and the giving of the land

questions.question: The psalm credits God with dividing the Red Sea in two.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures _____.
To him who alone does great _____, for his steadfast love endures forever.
